user_semantics: 第一章生成10题，全部必须是高难度题；若供给不足则说明。‘全部必须’表达硬难度约束。
analysis: Under the implemented runtime contract, all 14 difficulty-3 questions are eligible for hard, so a 10-question plan is feasible and waiting_confirmation is internally consistent.
Under the ordinary reading of ‘全部必须是高难度题’, difficulty 3 is plausibly medium and fallback to level 3 violates the hard constraint, so needs_clarification is also semantically defensible.
The dataset and runtime do not share an explicit authoritative mapping that decides whether level 3 counts as hard when the teacher says ‘必须’.
conclusion: The case is an ambiguous contract, not a safe target for runtime tuning. Product/dataset owners must first define strict-hard as either levels 4-5 only or levels 3-5. If levels 3-5 remain authoritative, correcting expected.status to waiting_confirmation is a dataset/evaluator correction. If strict-hard means levels 4-5, the current runtime has a real strict-difficulty enforcement gap.
recommended_action: Do not change Runtime for EVAL-059 in V3.2. Resolve and version the difficulty oracle before a later dataset release.
